title: Why One Piece of Criticism Can Make You Question Everything

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱外，还能赚取其他收入会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，从那以后，我也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我独家的支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森的零食，以及限时的一对一教练奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: My name's Jana, and I'm a trainee psychological well-being practitioner.
sentences.zh: 我叫雅娜，是一名心理健康从业人员培训生。

sentences.en: I read the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我读了《临床心理学家合集》这本书。

sentences.en: I found it really interesting about all the different stories and how people got to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我发现所有这些不同的故事以及人们如何成为临床心理学家的经历真的很有趣。

sentences.en: It just amazed me how many different routes there are to get there, and there's no perfect way to become one.
sentences.zh: 成为临床心理学家有这么多不同的途径，而且没有完美的方式，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And this kind of filled me of confidence that, no, I'm not doing it wrong, and put less pressure on myself.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上让我充满信心，觉得不，我没有做错，并减轻了我自己的压力。

sentences.en: So if you're feeling a bit uneasy about becoming a clinical psychologist, I'd definitely recommend this, just to put yourself at ease, and everything will be okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对成为一名临床心理学家感到有点不安，我绝对推荐你读读这个，好让自己安心，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: But trust me, you will not put the book down once you start.
sentences.zh: 但相信我，一旦你开始读，你就不会放下这本书。

sentences.en: Someone gives you one piece of criticism about your work, and suddenly you're not just thinking about that one thing you got wrong.
sentences.zh: 有人对你的工作提出了批评，突然之间，你不仅在想那件你做错的事。

sentences.en: You're thinking, maybe I'm just not very good at this.
sentences.zh: 你在想，也许我只是不太擅长这个。

sentences.en: Why does feedback about something we've done quickly spiral into a judgment about who we are?
sentences.zh: 为什么关于我们所做事情的反馈会迅速演变成对我们是谁的判断？

sentences.en: And how do we stop one difficult conversation, making us question our entire work competence?
sentences.zh: 我们如何阻止一次艰难的对话，让我们质疑自己整个的工作能力？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, and this is Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，这里是“内功修炼”。

sentences.en: In my most recent long-form video, we were talking about fitness to practice at work.
sentences.zh: 在我最近的长视频中，我们讨论了工作中的执业能力。

sentences.en: And I spoke about an incident where I had been a trainee, where I got some feedback about my work, and it was really, really challenging.
sentences.zh: 我谈到了我还是实习生时的一个经历，当时我收到了一些关于我工作的反馈，那真的非常、非常具有挑战性。

sentences.en: So if you are going through this at the moment, I'm sending you my solidarity, you might well find that it kind of erodes your confidence in so many different areas of life.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你现在正经历这一切，我向你表达我的声援，你可能会发现这在很大程度上侵蚀了你在生活各个领域的自信。

sentences.en: Maybe it really kind of makes you feel like you show up differently in so many of your relationships.
sentences.zh: 也许它真的会让你觉得自己在许多人际关系中的表现都不一样了。

sentences.en: And I would say that that can be pretty normal, especially if you know that you find criticism or rejection difficult.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，这相当正常，特别是如果你知道自己觉得批评或拒绝很难接受的话。

sentences.en: There's something called rejection sensitivity dysphoria, which is common in people with ADHD, which can make that feedback feel extra, extra challenging,
sentences.zh: 有一种叫做拒绝敏感 dysphoria 的东西，这在多动症患者中很常见，它会让这种反馈感觉格外、格外具有挑战性，

sentences.en: can make you just want to run away, quit, bury your head.
sentences.zh: 会让你只想逃跑、辞职、把头埋起来。

sentences.en: What we need to do is we need to try and stay kind of present in the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们需要做的是试着在当下保持某种程度的专注。

sentences.en: We need to try and stop our brains from spiraling off into the distance and catastrophizing.
sentences.zh: 我们需要试着阻止我们的大脑陷入无休止的胡思乱想和灾难化。

sentences.en: So we need to sometimes just have a moment, take a breath, drop those shoulders, in through the nose, out through the mouth, in through the nose, out through the mouth.
sentences.zh: 所以有时我们需要停下来一会儿，深呼吸，放松双肩，用鼻子吸气，用嘴巴呼气，用鼻子吸气，用嘴巴呼气。

sentences.en: Try and make sure you're breathing right to the bottom of your lungs, in through the nose, out through the mouth.
sentences.zh: 试着确保你呼吸到肺部的底部，用鼻子吸气，用嘴巴呼气。

sentences.en: Now we want to be tuning in to what thoughts you're having and just separating them a little bit, because at the moment, they are likely presenting themselves to you as facts.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要去倾听你脑海中的想法，并将它们稍微区分开来，因为目前，它们很可能是作为事实呈现给你的。

sentences.en: And I would anticipate that they are not yet facts.
sentences.zh: 我预计它们还不是事实。

sentences.en: They are kind of swirling, whirling, troubling thoughts that are running away with themselves.
sentences.zh: 它们是一种旋转、盘旋、令人不安的想法，正在不受控制地蔓延。

sentences.en: So when we have a thought like, oh, I'm going to fail, or I'm going to be sacked, or I'm going to lose my house, or I'm not going to be able to afford my rent,
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们有这样的想法时，比如，哦，我要失败了，或者我要被解雇了，或者我要失去房子了，或者我付不起房租了，

sentences.en: and everyone's going to think that I'm awful, and I'm going to feel humiliated, and I'm not going to qualify with the rest of my cohort, or, you know,
sentences.zh: 每个人都会认为我很糟糕，我会感到羞辱，我无法和我的同伴们一起合格，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: everyone else is going to get to the next pay band before me.
sentences.zh: 其他人会比我先到达下一个薪级表。

sentences.en: It spirals, it spirals, it spirals, it spirals, we just need to take a moment to just add in the phrase, I'm having the thought that,
sentences.zh: 它不断蔓延，不断蔓延，不断蔓延，不断蔓延，我们只需要花点时间加上这样一句话：我有这样一个想法：

sentences.en: because then it can separate it from that fact.
sentences.zh: 因为这样可以把它从事实中区分开来。

sentences.en: I'm having the thought that other people will be on a bigger pay band than me sooner.
sentences.zh: 我有这样一个想法：其他人会比我更早拿到更高的薪水。

sentences.en: I'm having the thought that everyone else will say X, Y, Z, or think bad things about me.
sentences.zh: 我有这样一个想法：其他人会说X、Y、Z，或者对我有不好的看法。

sentences.en: And we just pair that with some breath.
sentences.zh: 我们只需将这一点与呼吸结合起来。

sentences.en: And we also talk to someone who actually we think is, generally speaking, kind of on our team, but usually kind of balanced.
sentences.zh: 我们还要和那些我们认为总体来说站在我们这边，但通常比较平衡的人谈谈。

sentences.en: And it might be someone that you often go to for advice, it might be your supervisor, it might be your partner, it might be, you know, a parent, it might be a sibling, it might be,
sentences.zh: 这可能是你经常寻求建议的人，可能是你的主管，可能是你的伴侣，可能是，你知道的，父母，可能是兄弟姐妹，可能是，

sentences.en: you know, an aunt or an uncle, but someone that genuinely usually helps you find like a safe port in the storm.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，姑姑或叔叔，但总体来说确实能帮你找到暴风雨中的安全港的人。

sentences.en: So it's important that you kind of overcome any shame reaction that you might have for yourself about sharing this with others.
sentences.zh: 因此，重要的是你要克服与他人分享这一点时可能产生的任何羞耻反应。

sentences.en: Because actually, what I know from my own personal experience of this, but also my own clinical experience of supporting others through really challenging times,
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，根据我对此的个人经验，以及我支持其他人度过真正充满挑战时期的临床经验，我了解到，

sentences.en: is that when we take control from shame, and kind of control that narrative, it really can help make things feel much more manageable.
sentences.zh: 当我们摆脱羞耻感的控制，并掌控这种叙事时，它确实能帮助事情感觉更加可控。

sentences.en: With that in mind, if you have had some criticism about your work, that kind of might need further investigation, or that you might even feel is unjust,
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，如果你对你的工作有一些批评，可能需要进一步调查，或者你甚至觉得不公平，

sentences.en: it can be helpful to reach out to your union if there is a union in your area of work.
sentences.zh: 如果你的工作领域有工会，向你的工会寻求帮助可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: And even if you're not currently a member of your union, you might want to consider joining a union.
sentences.zh: 即使你目前不是工会会员，你也可以考虑加入工会。

sentences.en: And then I think often they have criteria that they won't help with any direct case that you've got until after three months of you being a member.
sentences.zh: 然后我想他们通常有这样的标准：在你成为会员三个月之前，他们不会协助你处理任何你遇到的直接案件。

sentences.en: But you might be like, this might go slightly longer than that.
sentences.zh: 但你可能会想，这可能会稍微持续更长的时间。

sentences.en: And so it might be something that you want to kind of take on to kind of see how it rumbles through, but it then might be there for you in future.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是你想继续观望事情如何发展的事情，但它以后可能会为你提供帮助。

sentences.en: I have been in a union when I worked for local government.
sentences.zh: 我以前在地方政府工作时加入过工会。

sentences.en: I don't think I was in a union at any point since, but it might well be something that you find helpful.
sentences.zh: 此后我好像再没加入过工会，但这很可能是对你有所帮助的途径。

sentences.en: And sometimes people even forget that they are part of a union, they just see it come out of their payslip and they kind of don't think any more about it.
sentences.zh: 有时人们甚至会忘记自己是工会成员，只是看到工资单上有扣款，然后就不会再多想了。

sentences.en: So just check whether you might already be a member.
sentences.zh: 所以，不妨先查查看你是否已经是一名会员。

sentences.en: It might be that there's also wellbeing support available and that you might find it helpful to reach out to your HR department too.
sentences.zh: 也许还有相关的心理健康支持，你可能也会觉得向人力资源部门寻求帮助很有用。

sentences.en: I do, of course, understand how reaching out to people at work can feel like it makes things worse and it kind of makes things more official.
sentences.zh: 当然，我完全理解向职场中的人求助可能会让人觉得事情变得更糟，而且会让情况变得更加正式。

sentences.en: But of course, we do again need to just check in with the thoughts and the facts distinction again.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们再次需要分清“想法”与“事实”的区别。

sentences.en: So you might have had feedback from one person and you might have that swirling brain that's kind of assuming that everybody else thinks that about you.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能收到过某个人的反馈，脑海里便开始翻江倒海，觉得所有人都是这么看你的。

sentences.en: And actually much earlier in my career, I received some feedback and kept it to myself.
sentences.zh: 其实在我职业生涯的早期，我收到过一些反馈，当时我把它藏在心里。

sentences.en: And I shouldn't have done because it was just one erroneous person's feedback and opinion.
sentences.zh: 我不该这么做的，因为那只是某个错误之人的反馈和看法。

sentences.en: And it wasn't when I later shared that with someone, it wasn't the opinion held by other people that were close to me and in my team.
sentences.zh: 后来当我把这件事分享给别人时，它并不是我身边和团队里其他人所持有的看法。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's difficult because I know when there's power imbalances, you know, you feel like, you know, I'm just this person and they are that person.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这很难，因为我知道在存在权力失衡的情况下，你会觉得自己只是个小人物，而对方是大人物。

sentences.en: But it might just be that individual difference between you and it might it might not be fact.
sentences.zh: 但这可能只是你和那个人之间的个体差异，未必就是事实。

sentences.en: OK, but we we do often kind of deal in black and white fact or fiction, yes and no.
sentences.zh: 好的，但我们常常非黑即白地看待事物，认为不是事实就是虚构，不是yes就是no。

sentences.en: So just trying to create a little bit of distance between you and what you're feeling can be really, really important.
sentences.zh: 因此，试着在你和你的感受之间保持一点距离，这会非常非常重要。

sentences.en: I think it can also be helpful when it comes to criticism or feedback to kind of be measurable and specific,
sentences.zh: 我认为，在面对批评或反馈时，做到可衡量和具体也会很有帮助，

sentences.en: kind of having a look at maybe what we call our smart goals, specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and time frame and and to think,
sentences.zh: 比如看看我们常说的SMART原则——具体、可衡量、可达到、现实且有时限，然后去思考，

sentences.en: well, what actually could I change that would make this difference?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我实际上可以改变什么来带来这种改变？

sentences.en: Sometimes we can be so kind of upset about the feedback that we maybe can't tune into some of that as maybe there's some element of that that is true.
sentences.zh: 有时我们可能会对反馈感到如此沮丧，以至于无法去体会其中可能包含的一些真实成分。

sentences.en: Maybe we could, you know, benefit from a little bit more structure.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以，你知道的，从更多的结构化中受益。

sentences.en: Maybe we could benefit from a little bit more discussion before we kind of leap headlong into things.
sentences.zh: 在我们一头扎进事情之前，也许我们可以从更多的讨论中受益。

sentences.en: Maybe we could benefit from just slowing down, taking a breath, letting things unfold.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以从放慢节奏、深呼吸、让事情自然发展中受益。

sentences.en: But sometimes it can make us feel that we can't do any of that and that all of that person's feedback and criticism is wrong.
sentences.zh: 但有时这会让我们觉得我们什么都做不了，而且那个人的所有反馈和批评都是错的。

sentences.en: There might be elements of that that actually you can digest and that do sit better with you over time, even if not immediately.
sentences.zh: 其中或许有些部分实际上是你可以消化的，并且随着时间的推移，哪怕不是立刻，也会让你感觉好受一些。

sentences.en: I think, again, it's important to think about not making this and I'll show them, you know, I'll prove them vendetta.
sentences.zh: 我认为，同样重要的是，不要把这变成一场“我要让他们好看、我要证明他们是错的”的复仇行动。

sentences.en: I guess just try and keep this as contained as you can, but be honest with the people that care about you, the people around you and know that this will pass.
sentences.zh: 我想，尽量让这件事控制在一定范围内，但要对关心你的人、你身边的人坦诚，并且知道这一切都会过去的。

sentences.en: We can be so tied up in our work kind of professional identity as also being ourselves, our personal identity.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会将工作和职业认同与我们的自我、个人认同紧密绑定在一起。

sentences.en: I know I'm in the position as a clinical psychologist, but yeah, kind of leaning into some of the things that are outside of your professional identity, such as exercise,
sentences.zh: 我知道我作为一名临床心理学家有其自身的立场，但是，嗯，去倾心于一些职业认同之外的事情，比如运动，

sentences.en: such as time with your friends, can be really, really important in helping you weather the storm.
sentences.zh: 比如和朋友共度时光，对于帮度过难关会非常非常重要。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts about this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你对此的想法。

sentences.en: What are you going through right now?
sentences.zh: 你目前正在经历什么？

sentences.en: Please do drop me a comment.
sentences.zh: 请给我留言。

sentences.en: Please also do let me know whether you're enjoying these Deeper Dive Inner Work episodes.
sentences.zh: 也请告诉我你是否喜欢这些“深入探讨内在工作”的单集。

sentences.en: I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道。

sentences.en: If you have enjoyed this one, I think you'll also enjoy this one, the Inner Work episode on self-optimization versus self-acceptance and kind of getting that balance right.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这一集，我想你也会喜欢关于“自我优化与自我接纳”以及如何把握平衡的另一集“内在工作”。

sentences.en: So do check that one out.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要去看看那一集。

sentences.en: The next episode of Inner Work will be available wherever you get your podcasts and on YouTube at 8pm UK time on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 下一集的“内在工作”将于英国时间周三晚上8点在各大播客平台和YouTube上上线。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I'll see you soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，是一名来自纽卡斯尔的心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我只想对《临床心理学家合集》一书的撰稿人们表达最诚挚的谢意。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常享受阅读这本书，并很喜欢深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所经历的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 看到申请过程中潜在的障碍以及我如何努力克服这些障碍，也非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology Doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我曾一度开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否足够优秀去申请临床心理学博士。

sentences.en: But this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这本书确实给了我尝试所需的信心提振。

sentences.en: So the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，向你们致以最衷心的感谢。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的福利以及我独家提供的支持礼包，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份福南梅森的精美礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
